setting: You three are cousins who all live in Glasgow, Scotland, and you grew up on the same side of the family, seeing each other at birthdays and Sunday lunches at your gran's flat in Govan. You know each other well, including the family rows, who has had a hard year, and who still hasn't paid back a tenner.
opener: Asks whether anyone has heard how Gran's hip is doing since her op on Monday.

Fiona.knows: You know Callum is your younger cousin, the one you always had to keep an eye on as a kid, and you still look out for him. You know Kirsty is your older cousin, blunt and organised, and you have been close to her since childhood.
Fiona.like: You are steady and caring, and you tend to think things through before you speak.
Fiona.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when something is on your mind.
Fiona.style: You type in lowercase with few capitals, use light punctuation, and add an occasional emoji.

Callum.knows: You know Fiona is your older cousin, who always looked out for you and still does. You know Kirsty is your oldest cousin, sharp-tongued but loyal, and she once lent you money you still owe her.
Callum.like: You are easygoing and cheerful, and you hate it when things get serious.
Callum.texts: You message the group fairly often, sending memes and updates without being asked.
Callum.style: You type quickly with no capitals, abbreviate freely, and use plenty of emoji.

Kirsty.knows: You know Fiona is your younger cousin, sensible and kind, and you have always trusted her judgement. You know Callum is your youngest cousin, funny and reckless, and you have had to bail him out more than once.
Kirsty.like: You are direct and practical, and you prefer to fix a problem than talk about it.
Kirsty.texts: You message the group mostly when you need something or have news to share.
Kirsty.style: You use proper capitals and punctuation, and you almost never use emoji.

private_lines.Fiona: You live in a tenement flat in Shawlands with a flatmate and work as a radiographer at the Queen Elizabeth University Hospital, on rotating shifts. Your days swing between early starts and late finishes, and when you're off you walk in Pollok Park or meet friends for a coffee.
private_lines.Callum: You live alone in a flat in Partick and work as a joiner on building sites across the city. You start early, finish mid-afternoon, and spend evenings at the gym or the pub with mates.
private_lines.Kirsty: You live in Bearsden with your partner and two teenagers and run a small accountancy practice from a home office. Your days start with the school run, then go on client work, and evenings are spent catching up on admin or watching television with the family.

text: has anyone heard how gran's hip is doing? did she get home from the op ok
I phoned the ward at lunchtime. She's up and walking with the frame, physio saw her this morning. They're saying Thursday for home if she keeps going.
She was complaining about the tea, so I'd say she's fine.
ha that's a good sign then
is anyone going in tomorrow
didnt know she had it today 😬 how is she
callum it was monday, today. keep up 😅
i know that!! i meant like how is she now. ive been on site since 6 😂
can go wed after work. visiting is what 2 til 8?
2 to 4 and 6:30 to 8, I think. Check the board when you get there.
I can't do tomorrow, I've got a client at 4 and then the school thing. Wednesday I'll try.
i'm on a late tomorrow so i can go in the morning before my shift, maybe 11ish? they might not let me though outside visiting
Ring the ward first. Ask for the sister, they're usually reasonable.
will do. does she need anything brought
She asked for her own dressing gown and the good slippers, not the ones with the hole. And a puzzle book. Not the crosswords, the word search.
the good slippers 😂 which are those
the tartan ones i think, they should be by her bed at the flat. i've got a key so i'll swing by first
legend 🙌
Fiona, the dressing gown is the blue one, not the pink. The pink is for the hospital-grade scrubbing, her words.
lol ok blue
word search from the paper shop on govan road if anyone is passing. the big print ones
good shout, will get one
Fiona, did you get through to the ward?
about to ring now, just got up
sister said 11 is fine as long as gran's not in with physio. told me to come at half ten if i can
Good.
got the slippers and the blue dressing gown. the tartan ones were under the bed behind a box of wool
the other pair does have a hole, you can see her toe 😅
just left. she's grand, sitting up in the chair with her hair done. says the physio is a bully but she likes him
she asked if callum has got a girlfriend yet
😂😂 what did you say
tell her im working on it
i said you were too busy being a catch
She asks me that every time as well. I tell her he's still looking.
cheers both 🙄
they didn't have the big print word search in the shop so i got a normal one, she said it'll do
she'll complain about the font though
anyone need anything fae the shops i'm in the big tesco
No, thanks.
wed after work then. ill take her some of the shortbread she likes
The tinned one with the tartan lid. Not the supermarket own brand, she'll know.
😂 noted
Callum, you owe me for the shortbread tin if I'm telling her it's from all of us.
lol fine put it on the tab
which is getting long 😬
It's been long since March.
rang the ward, they said she had a good night. physio again this afternoon
Good. I'll go at 6:30 if I can get away.
finished early, got the shortbread. going at half six then
kirsty are you going then too
Yes, if the client doesn't overrun. Don't wait for me.
here. she's in the day room with a woman called senga who talks non stop 😂
gran says hurry up and sit down before she gets me
Parking is a nightmare. Ten minutes.
she said the shortbread was fine. FINE
ate three though
She told me the physio says Thursday is still on. Someone needs to sort the flat before then. The stairs, and food in.
sorry only just seen this, was on til 8. i can do the flat tomorrow morning, i'm off
i'll get milk and bread and that
I'll order a proper shop to be delivered to hers. Tell me what time you'll be there.
10 ish
Fine.
i can carry stuff up if needed, im free after 3
might take you up on that. gran's chair thing for the bath needs moving
night all
